# Real metric samples captured from a LIVE Stakater Cloud cluster (us-2, 2026-07-20),
# Crossplane core v2.1.3 + Stakater upjet AWS providers v2.3.0 (provider-aws-s3 etc.).
#
# These are the metrics the pinned kind rig in tests/integration.sh CANNOT emit — they only
# register once composition Functions run (function_run_*), the realtime circuit breaker
# engages (circuit_breaker_*), or an Upjet provider reconciles resources (upjet_resource_*).
# Captured here (a real cluster that exercises those paths), so the referenced metrics are
# proven present WITH the labels the rules key on, and stay in metrics-allowlist.captured.txt.
# integration.sh feeds this file to capture-metrics.sh via --extra (same pattern as
# inventory-metrics.txt); the weekly kind capture does not overwrite it.
#
# Label contracts the rules depend on (verified in these samples):
#   function_run_function_response_total  -> function_name + result_severity (Normal|Fatal)
#   circuit_breaker_events_total          -> controller + result (Allowed|Dropped|HalfOpenAllowed)
#   upjet_resource_*_bucket               -> group/kind/version (+ le); NO `gvk` label

# --- Crossplane core: composition functions (Stories 5.1, 5.2) ---

# TYPE function_run_function_response_total counter
